mechanism.storedScenarios: resolveMany copies references, authenticates every C08 ref, groups case observations by digest of complete stored.caseRef, captures each projection/result, rereads every prepared C08 ref, then starts a separate final case-observation map. mechanism.units: Initial and final selected/baseline resolution use the optional batch. Existing independent stored-result digests, case identity, units, period, source refs, evidence freshness/accessRevision, rules and final host authority checks remain.
mechanism.legacyHost: resolveMany is optional. Without it the helper resolves individually and clones each observation. A batch refusal or wrong cardinality is not retried through a weaker individual fallback.
mechanism.noFinancialChange: The diff does not alter canonical formulas, thresholds, currency or missing-value rules, C10 state promotion, decision application, engines, identity policy or public output contracts.

authorityAndCorrelationReview.finding: No authority state is shared across requests or phases
authorityAndCorrelationReview.evidence: initialCases/finalCases are allocated inside resolveMany; context is passed to every C08, case and forecast call. Every later comparison/units phase creates a new batch.
All per-result rereads complete before the final case map begins; failed final case reads propagate. Current case digest must equal the captured initial digest.

authorityAndCorrelationReview.finding: Mutation of borrowed observations is fenced
authorityAndCorrelationReview.evidence: C08 reads, case reads, forecasts, references and returned values are copied before later awaits; initial caseDigest is captured before projection work.

authorityAndCorrelationReview.finding: Canonical output order and repeated refs are preserved
authorityAndCorrelationReview.evidence: The concrete stored resolver retains array order and returns one result per incoming reference; duplicate refs receive separate reads and cloned outputs.

authorityAndCorrelationReview.finding: Generic optional batch correlation remains a trusted-adapter obligation
authorityAndCorrelationReview.risk: The helper verifies cardinality but does not tag each entry with its requested reference. A custom resolveMany implementation must preserve ordering. authorityAndCorrelationReview.recommendation: Use the canonical published stored-scenario host for this intake; retain the owner's order/cardinality/refusal tests. Do not treat the optional batch callback as untrusted public input.

authorityAndCorrelationReview.finding: Legacy scheduling changes are not an authority relaxation
authorityAndCorrelationReview.risk: Units previously used Promise.all for two individual resolves; batch/fallback now performs staged or sequential work. This can alter latency and interleaving without changing authority checks; no wall-clock improvement is assumed.

oracles: A sibling batch makes two case observations while retaining all result rereads; another call and duplicate refs do not reuse observations or mutable outputs.
Batched units binding equals legacy binding, with six versus ten direct case reads and unchanged twelve C08 reads/four forecasts.
Comparison starts independent initial/final batches; simultaneous contexts stay separate and unauthorized admin is denied.
Different cases and historical producer versions preserve order, cardinality and missing-ref refusal.
Ledger, alternative and coverage changes between phases invalidate all siblings even without a case-version increment.
Authority revocation after all result rereads is caught by the fresh final case observation.
A real Planner source change during projection invalidates both stored siblings.
Borrowed store/case callback mutation cannot rewrite an earlier captured observation.
Wrong batch length and denied batch entries never fall back to individual resolution.
proofLimits: The test uses actual private UI authority, Planner commands/source issuer, persisted case and C08 APIs, but its inventory is intentionally conditioned; it is not full C10, installed-host or GNATIVE acceptance.
No accepted owner test run, complete control verdict, throughput result or current WP13 end-to-end performance result was verified by this review.
